name: Nana Patekar Rehne De (Welcome)
visual_description: Two-panel image of Nana Patekar as Uday Shetty in Welcome, looking tearful, emotional, and gesturing with his hand to dismiss or let go of something.
usage_context: Used to express giving up, asking someone to drop a topic, or helplessly letting something go after feeling frustrated or emotional.

example.top_text: When friend asks you to explain the topic one night before exam
example.bottom_text: Rehne de bhai, aane de back...

text_areas.description: Punchline or dialogue (Rehne de / Jaane do)
